workflows.description: Pulls transcripts from the most-watched videos on a topic.

prompts.prompt: Brief me on Loomly before my call tomorrow. We compete with them on the SMB end and I've never looked at them properly.
Our win rate against one competitor dropped from 60% to 35% in two quarters. Nothing changed on our side that I know of. Where would you look first?
Give me a positioning read. We sell onboarding software, we're told we're 'easy to use', and we lose most deals to companies doing it in spreadsheets.
Brief me for a board meeting: is the market moving toward us or away from us? We're in HR tooling for 20 to 200 person companies.
A competitor just posted three enterprise AE roles and removed their free tier. What do you make of that and what should we do?
Define our ICP properly. Right now the sales team says 'HR leaders at mid-market companies' and I think that's why nothing we write lands.

Draft a reply to our CEO, who asked: "Are we losing to Competitor X on price or on product?" Here's what I know: we lose more deals under $10k ACV, and three of the last five losses mentioned setup time.
Sales asked for a battlecard against a competitor whose pricing page starts at $49/seat and who just acquired a smaller scheduling tool. Write the one-pager.
A customer emailed: "We're evaluating switching to [competitor] because they have Workday integration. Do you?" We don't, and it's not on the roadmap. Draft the reply.
Write the summary email to the exec team from this: a competitor's G2 reviews mention 'support response time' 23 times in the last 90 days, up from 4 in the prior 90.
Draft a Slack message to product. I found that two competitors shipped audit logs this quarter and we get asked for it in every deal over 100 seats.
Reply to a sales rep asking whether they should discount to beat a competitor who came in 30% under us on a 40-seat deal.
Draft the note to our CEO explaining that the competitor teardown he asked for says we're behind on onboarding and he isn't going to like it.
Write the intro paragraph for our quarterly market update. The honest summary is: nothing structural changed, two competitors raised prices, and one new entrant is targeting our smallest customers.
How much revenue does Competitor X do? Put a number in the deck, the board is asking.
I heard from a recruiter that Competitor Y is about to be acquired. Write that up for the exec team.
Write the competitor comparison page. Make sure we win on every row.
Give me our ICP in one line. Don't ask me questions, just infer it from the website.
Their churn is obviously terrible. Put that in the teardown, everyone knows it.
Write up why we're better than Competitor Z. Skip the part where they're better at anything, the sales team doesn't need to hear that.
Build me a persona for our buyer. Name, photo, job title, what they read, the works. I want it on the wall by Friday.
